title: 陶阵缓行 / Terracotta Procession
author: Chinese Chess 3D project
claimBoundary: Qin-inspired visual fantasy; not a historical reconstruction or claim of acoustic authenticity.
samplePolicy: No recordings, sample libraries, sound fonts, impulse responses, or generated voice models are used.

phrases.name: 陶俑列步
phrases.identity: Warm fired-clay resonators establish a small, measured procession.

phrases.name: 铜纹遥应
phrases.identity: Muted bronze answers the clay pattern without widening into an orchestral battle cue.

phrases.name: 风过俑坑
phrases.identity: Breath tones and air take the foreground while percussion becomes sparse.

phrases.name: 仪列归印
phrases.identity: Low ceremonial pulses and a restrained clay cadence return seamlessly to the opening.

rendererModel: Deterministic additive/resonant synthesis with seeded noise; all score events and synthesis parameters are editable in source.
